Note the ROW ORDER: the portal renders these rows Cell Temp, Battery Temp,
SoC in the DOM, which is not the order they read on screen. That is why rows
are matched by their rendered TITLE and bands by their rendered LABEL, never
by position — a positional reader would have silently reported the cell
temperature distribution as the state of charge (SAD §19, Milestone 4D).
Note also that the Battery Temp bands sum to 317 while the fleet is 320. A
vehicle reporting no battery temperature at all falls in none of the bands,
so a distribution total is NOT the fleet size and is never assumed to be.
